1.9 Monitoring concept and tolerance definition
The NOx signal, O2 and Status Byte will be monitored with a NOx Checkbox via the CAN bus. When
the NOx Checkbox detects a signal out of specification/error condition it generates an error signal which
is monitored with the mask function of an oscilloscope and can be fed back to the test system.
In order to obtain a reliable data transmission outside of the RF chamber and to protect the Checkbox,
unless otherwise stated optical CAN transceivers are used. The NOx Checkbox has an internal CAN
termination of 120Ω, thus care should be taken to provide the other termination resistor for the bus, in
case the DUT does not assemble it, so the result are the standard 60Ω.
